description: Turn real performance data (pasted CSV exports, dashboard screenshots, or read-only API pulls from GSC, GA4, PostHog, Beehiiv and Kit) into an honest diagnosis, structured priors written to learnings.md, and 3-5 ranked next actions mapped to concrete skill invocations. Use after anything ships and has numbers (a campaign, a content batch, a sequence, an ad test), or on a monthly schedule. This is the skill that closes the loop, because every generator skill reads the priors it writes. Reads every channel's claimed results against the business's own count (the phone log for a local business, new-customer orders online) before giving any channel credit.
